# Bill of materials - Phase 2 - RK-1 TVC rocket

Masses are catalogue estimates; weigh every part. Prices are indicative USD. Propulsion baseline: certified 29 mm solid reload (F class first, G class after the flight gates), see docs/design-choices.md.

| Total on-board mass | Total cost (all lines, indicative) |
|---|---|
| **914 g** | **$523** |

Interactive version with live mass budget: [web/bom.html?model=rocket](../../web/bom.html?model=rocket). CSV: [rocket.csv](../../hardware/bom/rocket.csv).

## Structure

| ID | Item | Qty | Mass (g, each) | Price ($, each) | On-board | Specification / notes |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|:---:|---|
| R-01 | Carbon-fibre rods, 6 mm x 450 mm | 4 | 23 | 4 | yes | Solid or thick-wall tube, 6 mm dia - Cut to 425 mm, deburr, seal ends with CA. |
| R-02 | Stack plates (battery, PCB, telemetry) | 3 | 22 | 3 | yes | PETG/PA-CF, 110 mm square, 4 mm thick - Print flat, 4 perimeters, 40% gyroid. |
| R-03 | Landing frame (diamond plate with four hinge lugs) | 1 | 38 | 4 | yes | PA-CF recommended: heat from the motor and landing loads |
| R-04 | Landing legs 8 mm x 300 mm + rubber feet | 4 | 22 | 4 | yes | Carbon or aluminium tube, hinged at the landing-frame corner lugs - 34 deg from vertical, footprint 510 mm |
| R-05 | Leg braces (1.6 mm steel or CF rod) | 4 | 3 | 1 | yes | From gimbal mount to leg mid-point |

## Gimbal

| ID | Item | Qty | Mass (g, each) | Price ($, each) | On-board | Specification / notes |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|:---:|---|
| G-01 | Gimbal printed parts (mount, outer ring, collar) | 1 | 48 | 6 | yes | PA-CF or machined 6061 aluminium - Keep clear of exhaust: add a heat shield disc (G-06). |
| G-02 | Gear sector 36T + pinion 18T, module 1 (set) | 2 | 8 | 5 | yes | Acetal, nylon or printed PA; CAD names gear36t1 / gear36t2 - 2:1 reduction: servo travel = 2x gimbal travel. |
| G-03 | Digital metal-gear servo, 20 g class, HV | 2 | 22 | 18 | yes | >= 4.5 kg.cm @ 7.4 V, <= 0.08 s/60 deg, 6-8.4 V rated - Prefer a metal case for heat; buy a spare. |
| G-04 | Pivot pins M3 x 60 + 683ZZ bearings | 4 | 3 | 1 | yes | Hardened pins, 3x7x3 mm bearings - Zero play is a requirement: shim until backlash < 0.3 deg. |
| G-05 | Service-loop cable for servo 2 | 1 | 3 | 1 | yes | Silicone wire, strain-relieved - Servo 2 rides on the outer ring. |
| G-06 | Heat shield disc / ablative ring | 1 | 15 | 4 | yes | Aluminium 1.5 mm or phenolic - Aluminium disc under the gimbal; protects printed parts and wiring near the nozzle. |
